evidence.reason: The suffix gate at 641-643 returns `continue` before the dependency scan for any entry whose name is not one of `.service/.timer/.path/.socket/.target/.conf`. systemd's `[Unit]` section (including `Wants=`, `Requires=`, etc.) is shared across unit types, and `.slice` is a dependency-bearing unit type; a co-tenant `ingress.slice` with `Wants=crq-tick.service` is therefore not read at all. For an undeclared source the scanner would flag a name matching an expected unit as foreign (lines 672-679), exactly the case this skip suppresses, so a foreign activation edge is silently accepted and `discover` can report the topology supported. The inclusion of the non-unit `.conf` suffix while omitting `.slice` supports this being an oversight rather than a deliberate scope boundary; no accepted limitation covering it is present. Smallest compatible fix is to add dependency-bearing unit types (at minimum `.slice`) to the scanned suffix set so their `[Unit]` dependencies are evaluated by the existing logic.
